scope: One l14 move, fixed c5 domain and actual objectLayer; no browser rerun or app changes
classification: Driver assertion incompatible with actual derived-place eligibility after its selected move
mechanism: The move changes reached walk cells. With zero reached entrances and no reachable attached tree home or bench, derivePlaces omits P02:p3 and keeps P01 seeded; the shared tree and its gallery therefore have no eligible target. Exact graph choke-edge isolation was not separately run.

generality.domain: Ordinary derived places depend on ownership, position, growth, attachments and reached space.
generality.forestDelivery: Stage4 DEV replacement is bound to exact owner/cell/age/source matrix. Moved l14 loses this authored replacement.
generality.galleryDelivery: Bound to exact four owner cells, P02:p3 cluster stage, kit and source origin.
generality.conclusion: The authored rough composition is a fixture-specific appearance, not yet a general forest/gallery construction system that adapts that authored geometry to arbitrary growth or editing.
